titles: Mars: The Pristine Beauty of the Red Planet
Symphony for the City of the Dead
The Last Woman in the Forest
notes: Landscape, a low three-bay display unit in a public library ('Popular Hard Cover Fiction') photographed from the left at about 45 degrees, daylight from windows behind plus overhead light, reflections on the dust-jacket sleeves and on the shrink-wrapped Mars book. English throughout. The five display books on top read from their covers (Handbook of Bird Biology, Killers of the Flower Moon are partly overlapped by neighbours but readable); the rest from spines, all with library labels at the foot. Mostly the left bay reads; the middle and right bays are at a steep angle and only Battlemage, The 49th Mystic, Where the Crawdads Sing, Please Excuse This Poem and Shadows of the New Sun resolve there. Corrections to the draft: The Gilded Wolves (not Golden Wolf), Colder War (not Golden War); author-only entries (Linwood Barclay, Tom Clancy, Feist) dropped. Partial: The Twenty-Three (Linwood Barclay, spine half hidden behind Six of Crows). Left out: the George R. R. Martin, Dan Brown, Clive Cussler, Patricia Cornwell, Neil Gaiman, Tim Dorsey, Janet Evanovich and Eric Jerome Dickey spines where only the author reads, the two blank white display stands at the top right, the trolley of books at the far right, and the middle and right bays generally. Non-book items: a potted plant, library signage, a book trolley. Drafted by claude-sonnet-5 (extraction 76), verified by an agent.
